name: OML attributes
description: OML config keys for the core components, taken from the OGX.JS wiki and checked against the runtime the test app loads. Optional components keep their keys on read_runtime, on properties with in_oml true. A key here is config. It is not a method. Listed methods are the ones that page or that runtime shows. Do not invent members that are absent.

App.note: new OGX.App(options) returns the Core instance. Core is require('Core', 'Uxi', 'Touch'). The methods below are on that instance. App is not an OML node.

events.name: OGX.App.LOADING
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is AppLoading.

events.name: OGX.App.READY
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is AppReady.

events.name: OGX.App.DUPLICATE
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is AppDuplicate.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates with the router. The options object defaults to history true, reload false, and data null.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the router URL.

methods.name: getJSON
methods.description: Returns a clone of a preloaded JSON document.

methods.name: getOML
methods.description: Returns a clone of a preloaded OML document.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns one top-level key of the loaded app config.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Runs OGX.Net.refresh on the preloaded files.

methods.name: addStage
methods.description: Creates a stage, merges defaults.stage, and adds it. config.id is required. The third argument defaults to true.

methods.name: addPopup
methods.description: Creates a popup. The second argument is the Uxi to create it from. defaults.popup is merged into the config. Height auto is ignored unless scroll is true.

methods.name: addWindow
methods.description: Creates a window. The second argument defaults to the current stage. defaults.window is merged into the config.

methods.name: addOverlay
methods.description: Adds an overlay on a node. The anim falls back to defaults.overlay.anim. The node falls back to the current stage. Returns true when a node received it.

methods.name: removeOverlay
methods.description: Calls removeOverlay on the node. The node defaults to the current stage. Returns the app.

methods.name: getPopups
methods.description: Gathers Popup nodes. A string argument filters id with that regular expression.

methods.name: popupExists
methods.description: True when cfind finds a Popup with that id.

methods.name: findPopup
methods.description: Accepts an element, or an object with el. Walks up to .ogx_popup and returns that Popup. Returns false when none is found.

methods.name: getVisiblePopups
methods.description: Returns visible popups. The stage defaults to the current stage. Pass true to use children instead of gather.

methods.name: moveNode
methods.description: Detaches the node and attaches it to the parent. The third argument is passed to attach.

methods.name: dropNode
methods.description: Removes a Stage or a View from OGX.Stages or OGX.Views. Pass the node, or pass the name and the class name.

methods.name: isDarkMode
methods.description: Returns whether dark mode is on.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Swaps the media queries of the light and dark stylesheets.

methods.name: splash
methods.description: Returns the splash object when splash is set in the config. That object has show() and hide(callback). app.splash.hide() hides it and then destroys it. OGX.Splash.DONE is the string SplashDone.

App.catalog_status: Methods in this file are present on the object returned by new OGX.App in the runtime the test app loads. Further methods are not listed. Do not invent members that are absent.

Stage.note: Declare each stage in app.json vapps. always_on, placeholder, scope, and theater are vapp fields in oml://app. A route does not start with Stage.

fields.name: template
fields.description: Template name. The wiki example uses Stage.

fields.name: use
fields.description: Present on the wiki stage example as true. That page does not describe the key.

fields.name: anim
fields.description: Transition when switching stages. false, swap, or flip. If both stages set anim, each plays its own.

View.note: A route node is selector:Views.Name. The class file is require('Views.Name', 'View').

fields.name: id
fields.description: Id of the view. When omitted, OGX sets data-ogx-id. An id that starts with # is written as the element id.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector for the element.

fields.name: observe
fields.description: Mutation observer. Defaults to false.

fields.name: scroll
fields.description: Creates a Scroller that fills the view. Defaults to false.

fields.name: overlay
fields.description: Shows an overlay at start. Defaults to false.

fields.name: loading
fields.description: Shows a loading indicator at start. Defaults to false.

fields.name: html
fields.description: HTML rendered in the view.

fields.name: template
fields.description: Name of a template preloaded in OGX.Templater.

fields.name: css
fields.description: CSS class added to the view element. Avoid a class that changes display when the view sits in a Scroller or a Carousel.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Passed to the view constructor. A template reads it as {{$property}}.

Html.note: The wiki has no Html page. The html string is the field used by the test app and by the wiki examples.

fields.name: html
fields.description: HTML string rendered by this node.

Point.note: Range keys such as 0-479 are the node's own keys. Each value is the OML for that width. target is already listed on oml://runtime/Point.

Display.note: Display is a config object used by DynamicList, Roulette, Carousel, and GroupedList. It is not a selector:Display node. template supersedes html.

fields.name: template
fields.description: Template name, or {bind: property}. From 1.56.0, template.value may be a string or a global function. bind may be an OSE script. Defaults to false.

fields.name: html
fields.description: Markup for every item, such as {{$name}}. Defaults to false.

fields.name: oml
fields.description: OML for a placeholder. Defaults to false.

fields.name: css
fields.description: Class string, or the same bind form as template. Defaults to false.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Style function. Defaults to false.

Window.note: A sliding panel. A floating window is a Popup. Create it with app.addWindow. One placeholder is the body. node:OML renders into it. Width accepts a size expression.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique name.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Number, px, percent, or a size expression.

fields.name: min_width
fields.description: Minimum width.

fields.name: max_width
fields.description: Maximum width.

fields.name: min_height
fields.description: Minimum height.

fields.name: max_height
fields.description: Maximum height.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title.

fields.name: scroll
fields.description: Scrollable body. Defaults to false.

fields.name: blur
fields.description: The window handles view blur and focus. Defaults to true.

fields.name: html
fields.description: HTML appended to the window view.

fields.name: template
fields.description: Template appended to the window view.

fields.name: view
fields.description: View config instantiated in the default container.

fields.name: css
fields.description: Custom CSS class.

fields.name: head
fields.description: HEAD_NONE, HEAD_CLOSE, HEAD_BACK, or the strings none, close, back. The wiki comment names the default OGX.Window.STYLE_NONE.

fields.name: position
fields.description: POSITION_LEFT, POSITION_RIGHT, POSITION_TOP, POSITION_BOTTOM, or left, right, top, bottom. The wiki config line does not finish the default.

fields.name: anim
fields.description: ANIM_LEFT, ANIM_RIGHT, ANIM_TOP, ANIM_BOTTOM, or left, right, top, bottom.

fields.name: zindex
fields.description: Z-index.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Main icon.

fields.name: icons
fields.description: Toolbar icons.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Read as {{$}} when the OML content renders.

Popup.note: A floating box. app.addPopup is on the app. this.create('Popup', config) creates one from a Uxi. One placeholder is the body. Width and height accept a size expression.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique id.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Pixels as a number, or a percent or size expression.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Pixels as a number, or a percent or size expression.

fields.name: min_width
fields.description: Minimum width in pixels when resizable.

fields.name: min_height
fields.description: Minimum height in pixels when resizable.

fields.name: max_width
fields.description: Maximum width in pixels when resizable.

fields.name: max_height
fields.description: Maximum height in pixels when resizable.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Start x position.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Start position. The wiki text for this key says x position at start.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title.

fields.name: buttons
fields.description: Strings or objects.

fields.name: tabs
fields.description: Tab items, in the shape OGX.Tabs expects.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Path of the top-left icon.

fields.name: icons
fields.description: Icons in the top-right corner.

fields.name: scroll
fields.description: The body scrolls.

fields.name: drag
fields.description: The popup can be dragged.

fields.name: resize
fields.description: The popup can be resized.

fields.name: keep_ratio
fields.description: Keep the aspect ratio while resizing.

fields.name: center
fields.description: Keep the popup centered.

fields.name: maximize
fields.description: The popup can be maximized.

fields.name: maximize_dbc
fields.description: Double-click on the head maximizes the popup.

fields.name: group
fields.description: Group name for merging popups.

fields.name: group_icon
fields.description: Default icon for the group.

fields.name: html
fields.description: HTML placed in the body.

fields.name: template
fields.description: Template name for the body.

fields.name: anim
fields.description: Defaults to OGX.Popup.FADE. The string fade is the example. The test app uses scale.

fields.name: anim_param
fields.description: Defaults to {scale: 0.7}.

fields.name: zindex
fields.description: Z-index.

fields.name: css
fields.description: Class added to the body.

fields.name: view
fields.description: View configuration object.

fields.name: delay_oml
fields.description: Renders the OML content on the next thread.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Read as {{$}} when the OML content renders.

fields.name: swipe
fields.description: Set in the simple OML example. The main config block does not describe it.

fields.name: show
fields.description: Set in the simple OML example. The main config block does not describe it.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Sets the width, as in width(500). A call that reads the size returns the configured value, which may be the size expression. el.width() is the computed size.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Sets the height. The wiki example passes an anim flag and a callback. A read returns the configured value. el.height() is the computed size.

DynamicList.note: Extends List. In OML the selector is the element. display is a Display object. A non-uniform list sets display to {bind: property} and adds a displays map. key lets find, findDelete, update, replace, and restore skip the property argument.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector. In OML the selector on the node is this element.

fields.name: display
fields.description: Display object. See the Display entry. template, html, and css, or {bind: property} plus displays.

fields.name: displays
fields.description: Map of display objects keyed by the bound property value. A display may contain nested OML.

fields.name: display_max
fields.description: Maximum items to display.

fields.name: chunks
fields.description: Chunk size. Requires scroll. The wiki example uses 200.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: single, multi, toggle, hit, static, or set. Defaults to single. Runtime constants SELECT_MODE_SINGLE, SELECT_MODE_MULTI, SELECT_MODE_TOGGLE, SELECT_MODE_HIT, SELECT_MODE_SET, and STATIC hold those strings. hit fires and returns data without selecting. set keeps a selected item selected.

fields.name: reselect
fields.description: In mode single, select fires again when the item is already selected.

fields.name: reorder
fields.description: Tap-hold-drag to reorder. Defaults to false.

fields.name: swipe
fields.description: Items can be swiped. Defaults to false.

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: Triggers on rendering. Defaults to false.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Property shared by every item, such as id. Recommended.

fields.name: as
fields.description: Keyword for scope targeting. Defaults to item.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: The list follows scope. Defaults to true.

fields.name: list
fields.description: Items.

fields.name: selection
fields.description: Key values to select. Requires key.

fields.name: no_selection
fields.description: Describes items that cannot be selected.

fields.name: max_selection
fields.description: Maximum selected items. mode must be multi.

fields.name: shift_selection
fields.description: Shift selects a range. mode must be multi.

fields.name: filter_remove_selection
fields.description: Drops filtered-out items from the selection. Defaults to true.

fields.name: callbacks
fields.description: select, unselect, and render. At runtime the same hooks are onSelect, onUnselect, and onRender.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the item array.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Sorts by a shared property. The wiki example uses 1 for ascending and -1 for descending.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Sets the key. Call it before passing a list.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an object or an array. An omitted index appends.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the display index. The item must be displayed.

methods.name: deleteSelection
methods.description: Deletes the selected items.

methods.name: findDelete
methods.description: Finds and deletes items and returns them. With key set, the property can be omitted: findDelete(10, 1). Without key: findDelete('id', 10, 1).

methods.name: findReplace
methods.description: Replaces the first match. Returns true or false.

methods.name: findUpdate
methods.description: Updates matches with a partial or complete object. Returns the number of updated items.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Index of the first object with that property and value.

methods.name: replaceAt
methods.description: Replaces the object at an index.

methods.name: refreshAt
methods.description: Renders the item at an index.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: HTML element of the first property and value match.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Adds matches to the selection and returns it. Single mode returns the object.

methods.name: unselect
methods.description: Removes a match from the selection.

methods.name: selectIndex
methods.description: Selects a display index.

methods.name: unselectIndex
methods.description: Unselects a display index.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Selected objects. Pass true to get the selected elements. Defaults to false. The wiki says the object form is an OGX.List.

methods.name: resetSelection
methods.description: Clears the selection.

methods.name: index
methods.description: With no argument, returns selectedIndex. With an index, selects that index.

methods.name: noSelection
methods.description: Sets, enables, or disables the no-selection option.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a sided item by property and value.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls to an item. Requires scroll. Added in 1.32.0.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the list.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SELECT
events.description: An item was selected. The event string is DynamicListSelect.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.UNSELECT
events.description: An item was unselected. The event string is DynamicListUnselect.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.DELETE
events.description: The event string is DynamicListDelete.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SWIPE_LEFT
events.description: The event string is DynamicListSwipeLeft.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SWIPE_RIGHT
events.description: The event string is DynamicListSwipeRight.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.BACK_HIT
events.description: A sided item's background was tapped. The event string is DynamicListBackHit.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SIDED
events.description: An item was set aside in SWIPE_MODE_SIDE. The event string is DynamicListSided. The payload has the side and the item.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.HOLD
events.description: A drag started after a tap-hold of about 2 seconds. The event string is DynamicListHold.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.RELEASE
events.description: Runtime constant beside HOLD. The event string is DynamicListRelease. The wiki events section does not describe it.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.DROP
events.description: A reorder drag ended. The event string is DynamicListDrop.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.RENDER
events.description: The list rendered. Also used to track filtering. The event string is DynamicListRender.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.READY
events.description: Fired once when the component is ready. The event string is DynamicListReady.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SELECT_FILTERED
events.description: The selection changed because of filtering. The event string is DynamicListSelectFiltered.

events.name: OGX.DynamicList.SELECT_UNFILTERED
events.description: The selection was reset because of filtering. The event string is DynamicListSelecUnfiltered.

Tree.note: A node is {type, label, state, data, items}. state is open or close. type must exist in types. A type is {mode: file|folder}. Folder mode may set an empty icon. Selected content gets ogx_tree_selected_item. data-compound values look like root-open.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Element that contains the tree.

fields.name: editable
fields.description: Drag and drop.

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Defaults to {enabled: true, property: 'label', way: 1}. way -1 is ascending and way 1 is descending.

fields.name: toggle
fields.description: A selected item can be unselected.

fields.name: icon_path
fields.description: Folder that holds the icons.

fields.name: icon_size
fields.description: Icon width. Defaults to 30.

fields.name: types
fields.description: Map of types. Each value has mode file or folder.

fields.name: data
fields.description: The tree. Each node has type, label, optional state open or close, optional data, and items.

fields.name: show_root
fields.description: Defaults to true.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item as a child. The id argument is optional and falls back to the selected item.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Item by id.

methods.name: getItemByPath
methods.description: Item by path.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: The selected item.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Selects by id.

methods.name: openItem
methods.description: Opens by id.

methods.name: closeItem
methods.description: Closes by id.

methods.name: selectItemByPropVal
methods.description: Selects by a property and a value.

methods.name: selectItemByPath
methods.description: Selects by path.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates an item. render defaults to true and redraws the children.

methods.name: replaceItem
methods.description: Replaces the item with the same id.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes by id.

methods.name: deleteSelectedItem
methods.description: Deletes the selected item.

methods.name: getTree
methods.description: Returns the data tree.

methods.name: setTypes
methods.description: Sets the types config.

methods.name: setTree
methods.description: Sets the data tree.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets types and the tree from one object, {types, tree}.

methods.name: newTree
methods.description: Removes the previous tree.

events.name: OGX.Tree.DRAG
events.description: A drag started. The event string is TreeDrag.

events.name: OGX.Tree.DROP
events.description: A drop. The event string is TreeDrop.

events.name: OGX.Tree.OPEN
events.description: A node opened. The event string is TreeOpen.

events.name: OGX.Tree.CLOSE
events.description: A node closed. The event string is TreeClose.

events.name: OGX.Tree.SELECT
events.description: A node was selected. The event string is TreeSelect.

events.name: OGX.Tree.UNSELECT
events.description: A node was unselected. Requires toggle. The event string is TreeUnselect.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Two items of {label, value}. Defaults to [{label: 'OFF', value: 0}, {label: 'ON', value: 1}].

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Show labels. Defaults to true.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Current value. A data-value attribute on the element is read with OGX.Data.stringToVal and then removed.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Animation speed in milliseconds. Defaults to 250.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the switch.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets the value, or sets it. The second argument triggers CHANGE when true.

events.name: OGX.Switch.CHANGE
events.description: The value changed. The event string is SwitchChange. OGX.Switch.BIND is the same constant.

Tabs.note: An item is {label, icon, enabled} or a string label. icon is required when icons is true.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: list
fields.description: Tab items. The wiki config block lists this key twice.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: add
fields.description: The user can add a tab with the + button.

fields.name: remove
fields.description: The user can remove a tab by dragging up or with the close icon.

fields.name: icons
fields.description: Show icons. Defaults to false.

fields.name: icon_path
fields.description: Folder that holds the icons.

fields.name: icon_default
fields.description: File name of the default icon.

fields.name: min_width
fields.description: Minimum tab width.

fields.name: max_width
fields.description: Maximum tab width.

fields.name: add_width
fields.description: Width of the add button.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Tab selected at start.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a tab.

methods.name: addAt
methods.description: Inserts a tab at an index.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a tab by property and value.

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes the tab at an index.

methods.name: removeCurrent
methods.description: Removes the current tab.

methods.name: enableTab
methods.description: Enables the tab at an index.

Tags.note: string mode uses arrays of strings. object mode uses {label} and stores a typed tag as {label: text}. strict true allows only a proposed tag. restrict true uses the Form default, or pass a Form.restrictField object.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: add
fields.description: The user can type to search or add tags.

fields.name: remove
fields.description: The user can remove tags.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of a hidden field that holds the value.

fields.name: required
fields.description: Required flag of that hidden field, when name is set.

fields.name: lowercase
fields.description: Saves the typed tag in lowercase.

fields.name: max
fields.description: Maximum tags the user can add.

fields.name: display_max
fields.description: Maximum suggestions to display. The wiki also describes this as adding a +N other tag.

fields.name: display_more
fields.description: Shows a +N other tag at the end of the list.

fields.name: click_more
fields.description: With display_more, a click shows every tag.

fields.name: hide_input_on_disable
fields.description: Hides the input when the component is disabled.

fields.name: tags

fields.name: current_tags

fields.name: tags_ascii

fields.name: image

fields.name: mode

fields.name: placeholder
fields.description: Placeholder of the input.

fields.name: restrict
fields.description: true uses the default Form restriction. An object is a Form.restrictField config.

fields.name: strict
fields.description: The user can only pick a proposed tag. Defaults to false.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the user tags. val(array) sets them. val(property, value) sets them by lookup. val() returns them.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Gets or sets the autocomplete tags.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes every user tag.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a user tag.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a user tag. The wiki comment on that line says Add.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Gets or sets the display of the internal lists.

events.name: OGX.Tags.ADDED
events.description: A user tag was added. The event string is TagsAdded. The wiki page writes TAG_ADDED, which is not the runtime constant.

events.name: OGX.Tags.REMOVED
events.description: A user tag was removed. The event string is TagsRemoved. The wiki page writes TAG_REMOVED, which is not the runtime constant.

events.name: OGX.Tags.CHANGE
events.description: A tag was added or removed. The event string is TagsChange. OGX.Tags.BIND is the same constant.

events.name: OGX.Tags.SELECT

fields.name: id

fields.name: tabs

fields.name: carousel
fields.description: Carousel config.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Index to select.

fields.name: node:OML
fields.description: Child OML, one node per pane.

fields.name: flatten
fields.description: Width at which the container flattens.

properties.name: tabs

fields.name: el

fields.name: views

fields.name: blur

fields.name: index

fields.name: list

fields.name: display

GroupedList.note: One level of grouping. The stack is GroupedList, List, NestList, DynamicList. group_order follows NestList ordering.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: display
fields.description: Display object for the items.

fields.name: list
fields.description: The data, an array or an OGX.List.

fields.name: group_by
fields.description: Shared property used to group.

fields.name: group_mode
fields.description: substr, numrange, or date.

fields.name: group_param
fields.description: numrange can be 500 or [500, '$', 'pre']. date can be [30, 'YYYY-MM']. pre and post place the symbol.

fields.name: group_order
fields.description: Preferred nest order. See NestList.

Scroller.note: Prefer the scroll flag on a view, window, or popup. The container height must be px or percent. The wiki names inner() and outer(). This catalog lists getInner and getOuter.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector of the container.

fields.name: auto_scroll
fields.description: Scrolls down when content is added. Defaults to true.

fields.name: zindex
fields.description: Defaults to 9999.

fields.name: observe
fields.description: Redraws when content is added or removed. Defaults to true.

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: user_scroll
fields.description: Defaults to true.

events.name: OGX.Scroller.READY
events.description: The scroller can receive content. The event string is ScrollerReady. The wiki listens on the container and then turns the listener off.

events.name: OGX.Scroller.TOP
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is ScrollerTop.

events.name: OGX.Scroller.BOTTOM
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is ScrollerBottom.

events.name: OGX.Scroller.SCROLL
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is ScrollerScroll.

events.name: OGX.Scroller.START
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is ScrollerStart.

events.name: OGX.Scroller.END
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is ScrollerEnd.

Scroller.catalog_status: OML config fields are from the OGX.JS wiki. Methods already in this file stay. The wiki names inner() and outer(); this file lists getInner and getOuter. Do not invent members that are absent.

Calendar.note: Needs GridSwiper. The default layouts are decade years, years months, and month days. simple true keeps the single month-days layout and is the behavior from before 1.27.0. Set simple false when you pass your own layouts.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique id.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector of the target element.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Selected date. A parseable string or a Date.

fields.name: display_date
fields.description: Date to display. A parseable string or a Date.

fields.name: selectable
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: no_selection
fields.description: Dates that cannot be selected. The values match the layout format.

fields.name: select_past
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: select_future
fields.description: Defaults to true. The runtime key is select_future.

fields.name: off_dates
fields.description: Dates displayed as off.

fields.name: swipe
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: browse
fields.description: Shows the navigation buttons. Defaults to true.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: select or toggle. Defaults to select.

fields.name: layouts
fields.description: Custom layouts. simple must be false.

fields.name: layout
fields.description: Default layout index. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: simple
fields.description: true keeps the month-days layout only.

fields.name: callbacks
fields.description: select, unselect, and render. At runtime the same hooks are onSelect, onUnselect, and onRender.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the selected date. val('2023-04-05', false) sets it without re-rendering.

methods.name: resetSelection
methods.description: Clears the selected date.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Gets or sets the displayed date.

methods.name: axis
methods.description: Locks an axis when several layouts are active.

events.name: OGX.Calendar.SELECT
events.description: The event string is CalendarSelect.

events.name: OGX.Calendar.UNSELECT
events.description: The event string is CalendarUnselect.

events.name: OGX.Calendar.BROWSE
events.description: The event string is CalendarBrowse.

events.name: OGX.Calendar.LAYOUT_CHANGE
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is CalendarLayoutChange.

GridSwiper.note: A 5-cell cross. The map is a 2D array. The depth follows the series around the start cell. A horizontal pair of panels is a Carousel.

fields.name: el
fields.description: HTML element.

fields.name: map
fields.description: 2D array of cell content.

fields.name: start
fields.description: Point of the cell shown at start. Defaults to the center of the map.

fields.name: loop
fields.description: Infinite loop.

fields.name: axis
fields.description: Defaults to {x: true, y: true}.

events.name: OGX.GridSwiper.SWIPE_LEFT
events.description: The event string is GridSwiperSwipeLeft.

events.name: OGX.GridSwiper.SWIPE_RIGHT
events.description: The event string is GridSwiperSwipeRight.

events.name: OGX.GridSwiper.SWIPE_UP
events.description: The event string is GridSwiperSwipeUp.

events.name: OGX.GridSwiper.SWIPE_DOWN
events.description: The event string is GridSwiperSwipeDown.

events.name: OGX.GridSwiper.SWIPE_START
events.description: The event string is GridSwiperSwipeStart.

events.name: OGX.GridSwiper.SWIPE_END
events.description: The event string is GridSwiperSwipeEnd.

Iceberg.note: Up to five placeholders. main matches the container. A side can be a size string such as 50% or 100px, or an object with width and html. main is not required for a simple panel.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: left
fields.description: Width string, or an object with width and html.

fields.name: top
fields.description: Height string, or an object.

fields.name: main
fields.description: Main pane. Optional for a simple panel.

fields.name: right
fields.description: Width string, or an object with width and html.

fields.name: bottom
fields.description: Height string, or an object.

NestList.note: One nest per item. An item is {title, scope, open}. scope on an item is an array. order keeps named nests in place when items are added or removed.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Element that holds the component.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Defaults to public.

fields.name: list
fields.description: Items. Each item has title, an optional scope array, and open.

fields.name: map
fields.description: Property map for title and scope.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Titles that must stay in this order.

TreedList.note: Groups a list into a tree and renders it. renderer is Tree, StackedTree, or RouletteTree. Tree is the default and needs types.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: types
fields.description: Required when renderer is Tree. The same types object Tree expects.

fields.name: renderer
fields.description: Tree, StackedTree, or RouletteTree. Defaults to Tree.

fields.name: list
fields.description: Items. An OGX.List is preferred.

fields.name: group_by
fields.description: Properties to group by.

fields.name: group_mode
fields.description: Grouping mode.

fields.name: group_param
fields.description: Grouping options. An array or a string.

StackedTree.note: Shows one level and a path back. A node is {label, icon, scope, items}. label is required. Needs DynamicList.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Scope.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Transition speed. Defaults to 200.

fields.name: list
fields.description: Nodes. Each has label, optional icon, optional scope, and optional items.

Roulette.note: A slot-machine cylinder. data-value on the element is read with OGX.Data.stringToVal and then removed. mode is a constant. This file does not name the mode values.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Selector.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Defaults to true.

fields.name: list
fields.description: Strings or objects.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value shown at start.

fields.name: keys
fields.description: See the keys section of the wiki.

fields.name: search
fields.description: See the search section of the wiki.

fields.name: drag
fields.description: Drag to change the value. Defaults to true.

fields.name: display
fields.description: Display object.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: A Roulette mode constant. The config line does not name the values.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name.

fields.name: required
fields.description: Defaults to false.

RouletteTree.note: One Roulette per group. Outside TreedList the data is a nested object, such as canada.ontario.toronto, and groups is ['country', 'state', 'city']. Other Roulette config keys apply.

fields.name: el
fields.description: Where to create the component.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Nested object tree when used outside TreedList.

fields.name: groups
fields.description: Level names, one per Roulette.
